• Experience delivering software systems for DoD customers

A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you'll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer's missions and driven by a higher purpose - to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust. CACI takes pride in fostering a diverse and accessible culture where every individual feels supported to chart their own path. job_description:
Center 1 (19052), United States of America, McLean, VirginiaManager, Data Scientist, Generative AI Systems (Genesis)

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The Generative AI Systems (Genesis) team within Card Data Science builds state-of-art, generative AI-based solutions for dialogue, text summarization, reading comprehension, speech recognition, image/document processing as well as time-series sequencing modeling. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver internal applications based on these solutions that drive efficiency in our business and data analytics teams, as well as customer-facing applications that enhance the customer experience. You will work with a seasoned group of natural language processing (NLP), speech, and computer vision specialists, experimenting with emerging technologies in generative AI, delivering software implementing these technologies, and contributing research to major NLP and AI/ML conferences.

Role Description

In this role, you will:
• Train, fine-tune, and customize large language models across multiple modalities--text, speech, and vision--for use in downstream applications such as dialogue and image processing.
• Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
• Leverage a broad stack of technologies — PyTorch, Hugging Face, Spark, LangChain and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
• Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
• Contribute research to top-tier NLP conferences such as Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL) and Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)

The Ideal Candidate is:
• Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
• Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
• Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
• Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.

Basic Qualifications:
• Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree plus 6 years of experience in data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus 4 years of experience in data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining PhD plus 1 year of experience in data analytics, with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date
• At least 2 years’ experience in open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
• At least 2 years’ experience with machine learning
• At least 2 years’ experience with relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:
• PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) or non-STEM but AI-adjacent field plus 3 years of experience in data analytics
• At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
• At least 4 years’ experience in Python for large scale data analysis
• At least 4 years’ experience with machine learning
• At least 4 years’ experience with SQL

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The DSS group is part of Zifo’s Innovation and Emerging Services organization. Zifo serves the pharmaceutical, biotech, and health industries by accelerating the discovery, development, and manufacturing of new drugs, therapies, and vaccines—to save lives faster!

Coordinate with external stakeholders, clients & technology partners for planning & executions

Architect complex AIML solutions and deploy in production environments,

Support the leadership to further develop & grow data science business.

Qualifications &

Bachelor’s or master’s in data sciences / computer science/engineering or related field 

2-3 years professional experience in an AI / ML engineer role

Experience designing, developing & deploying complex AIML solutions,

Experience with Data & ML lifecycle management, MDLC, and MLOps,

Experience with traditional ML, deep learning, and/or generative AI,

Experience working with major data modalities (text, images, omics, graphs, etc.)

Expertise in programming languages & ML libraries (Python, Spark, Tensor Flow, PyTorch, etc.)

Experience with cloud deployment for AIML solutions (Azure, AWS, GCP, Data Bricks, etc.)

Good To Have:

Background in health sciences or experience working with health or real-world data,

Background in life sciences or experience working with omics data for AIML.

A successful “Zifo-ite” is:

Independent, self-motivated & results driven,

Quickly & continually acquires new skills & business principles,

Critical thinker who possesses logical reasoning, and

Curious and always looking for creative solutions to complex problems.

Benefits

About Zifo:

CURIOSITY DRIVEN, SCIENCE FOCUSED, EMPLOYEE BUILT. Our culture is unlike any other, one where we debate, challenge ourselves, and interact with all alike. We are a curious bunch, characterized by our passion to learn and spirit of teamwork. Zifo is a global R&D solutions provider focused on the industries of Pharma, Biotech, Manufacturing QC, Medical Devices, specialty chemicals and other research-based organizations.

Our team’s knowledge of science and expertise in technology help Zifo better serve our customers around the globe, including 7 of the Top 10 Biopharma companies.

We look for Science – Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Microbiology etc. We possess scientific and technical knowledge and bear professional and personal goals. While we have a “no doors” policy to promote free access within, we do have a tough door to walk in. We search with a two-point agenda – technical competency and cultural adaptability.

Our Opportunity:

We're attempting something that's likely impossible: building AI systems that operate at a level of sophistication that makes current approaches look like toys. If you're satisfied writing prompts for large language models or fine-tuning existing architectures, stop reading now.

The next breakthrough in AI won't come from just algorithms—it will come from mastering the architecture of knowledge itself. While others focus on model parameters, we believe the real challenge lies in orchestrating the vast, chaotic sea of human and machine intelligence into something unprecedented. Most attempts at knowledge management focus on organizing documents, treating information as something to be filed away and retrieved. We see a different path.

We're building neural pathways for a new kind of intelligence—one that doesn't just store knowledge, but breeds it. Our system takes insights and generates new ones, transforms patterns into discoveries, and grows not linearly but exponentially. It creates connections that neither humans nor machines could make alone, leading to discoveries that no individual expert could conceive. This isn't just a database of what we know; it's an engine for discovering what we don't even know to look for.

What You'll Really Be Signing Up For:
• Weeks of frustration as your "brilliant" solutions fall apart
• Regular encounters with problems that make you question your abilities
• The need to challenge and rebuild fundamental assumptions about machine intelligence

What You’ll Do:

You'll architect a system that transforms raw knowledge into evolving intelligence. This isn't about building databases—it's about creating neural pathways that grow, adapt, and generate new insights. Your architecture will turn today's discoveries into catalysts for tomorrow's breakthroughs, breeding new knowledge from existing patterns.

But you won't build this alone. Your greatest innovation will be in creating and orchestrating a workforce of AI agents that extend far beyond traditional automation. These digital experts will harvest insights across the industry, see patterns humans miss, and transform discoveries into new capabilities. Each breakthrough cascades through the system, spawning new agents with enhanced understanding.

As this collective intelligence grows, you'll guide its evolution toward ever-greater discovery. Each generation of agents becomes smarter than the last, forming connections humans never imagined. This isn't iteration - it's intellectual compound interest, where yesterday's breakthroughs become the foundation for tomorrow's revelations.

Who You Are:
• You get motivated when told something is impossible
• You have a track record of solving problems others deemed impossible
• You have the intellectual honesty to abandon your own ideas when better ones emerge
• You build complex systems from first principles because existing solutions aren't good enough.
• You're comfortable being deeply wrong and learning from spectacular failures

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Preferred: Advanced degrees (Master’s or PhD) in AI, Knowledge Management, Systems Engineering, or Cognitive Science.
• Proven track record of building complex AI/ML systems or knowledge frameworks.
• At least 1+ years of experience in developing and deploying AI systems, knowledge architectures, or related technologies.
• Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in AI development (e.g., Python, Java etc.).
• Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, knowledge representation techniques and neural networks,
• Strong skills in data modeling, ontology creation, and semantic reasoning.
• Knowledge of secure system design to ensure data integrity and prevent misuse of AI systems.
• Exceptional problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to address undefined or ambiguous challenges.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in conveying complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Some travel may be required.

Highly Desirable:

Research & Development:
• Publications or patents in AI, knowledge systems, or related areas.
• Contributions to open-source projects in machine learning or knowledge engineering.

Industry Experience:
• Hands-on experience with AI-powered knowledge management tools like knowledge graphs, large language models, or agent-based systems.
• Exposure to dynamic industries, such as e-commerce, where knowledge intelligence drives innovation.
• Experience creating, building using graph db in production and research environments.

At Capital One, we are dedicated to creating responsible and reliable AI systems that change banking for good. • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or AI, plus at least 3 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies.
